body_lead: Uttar Pradesh – INDIA, 01 August, 2026 – Artificial Intelligence is transforming industries and creating unprecedented career opportunities. Yet for many young women, particularly those from smaller cities, the biggest barrier to entering the technology workforce is not ambition—it is access to practical skills, industry exposure and the confidence to turn learning into a career. Across Uttar Pradesh, Samsung Innovation Campus (SIC) is helping bridge that gap.
